claims.quote: The gamma-aminobutyric acid A receptor, gamma 2 (GABRG2) gene encodes the GABR2 protein, which has been implicated in susceptibility to epilepsy.

Meta-analysis showed a significant association between this polymorphism and susceptibility to FS in a codominant (TT vs. CC, OR 0.47, 95% CI 0.30-0.73, p=0.0008 and TT vs. CT, OR 0.59, 95% CI 0.42-0.83, p=0.003) and dominant (OR 0.54, 95% CI 0.39-0.75, p=0.0002) genetic models, influenced by two studies with small sample size.
Neither allele nor genotype association was observed with IGE.
